# Representative native-format fixtures

These are small, referentially closed excerpts, NOT complete taxonomy releases.
They retain native headers, quoting, multiline descriptions and source identifiers.
Generated test ZIPs are assembled in memory; no production taxonomy is seeded by tests.

- ESCO: European Commission, ESCO v1.2.1, classification, English CSV.
  Derived from the user's root-folder release, supplied 2026-10-01.
  Source: https://esco.ec.europa.eu/en/use-esco/download
- O*NET: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration,
  O*NET Database 29.0 (August 2024), native tab-delimited text.
  Source: https://www.onetcenter.org/dl_files/database/db_29_0_text.zip
  License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://www.onetcenter.org/license_db.html

See docs/verification for full-package checksums, file hashes, row counts and
provenance. ESCO 1.2.0 and other O*NET versions are not supported by this contract.
